name: Nose
overview: The Bible uses the nose symbolically in various ways, highlighting both adornment and judgment. Scripture speaks of nose jewels as ornaments of beauty and status, as seen in Isaiah 3:21 and Ezekiel 16:12, where the nose is associated with precious decorations. Conversely, Ezekiel 23:25 depicts the removal of the nose as a severe punishment, signifying humiliation and destruction. Proverbs 11:22 contrasts external beauty with discretion, likening a fair woman without wisdom to a gold jewel in a swine’s snout, underscoring the importance of inner character over outward appearance.
